id: title:Gilbert09:stop sync queue outages disabling source schemas

review.posthog_relevance: Preservation of customer-facing reliability by distinguishing PostHog infrastructure transient errors from customer warehouse failures, preventing false-positive failure attribution.
review.reason: Adds a dedicated exception class and context manager to classify transient PostHog queue database errors separately from customer warehouse errors. This wrapper is applied to database connections and batch operations, preventing internal transient failures from being propagated as warehouse failures. This is a substantive, bounded correctness and reliability improvement.
review.uncertainty: The actual runtime behavior and the specific transient error conditions handled are not demonstrated in the provided hunk descriptions; the benefit relies on the implementation of the classification logic and the existence of the transient errors, which are not independently verified here.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected.

observations.behavior: Adds type and context-manager imports, and a new exception class, to distinguish PostHog's own queue database errors from customer warehouse errors.
observations.posthog_connection: This wrapper prevents transient PostHog infrastructure errors from being misclassified as customer warehouse failures, preserving customer-facing reliability.

observations.behavior: Wraps database connection and batch operations with the new error-wrapping context manager.
observations.posthog_connection: Applies the classification wrapper to connection establishment, ensuring transient internal errors do not propagate as warehouse failures.

observations.behavior: Wraps batch superseding and row insertion operations with the error-wrapping context manager.
observations.posthog_connection: Applies the classification wrapper to batch metadata and row insertion, protecting customer-facing operations from transient internal database errors.
